summary: Verified iteration 6 fixes end-to-end on live preview. Backend: 7/7 pytest live cases in test_review_iteration6.py (quick commands for admin+staff, admin takeover 409 when report in review, approve staff report credits the player, takeover works for an 'assigned' staff deposit, admin player inventory/balance/skin-remove routes, /api/upgrade no longer rejects with 'unavailable prize'/'payout limit' text). Frontend: admin login (10-word seed), admin→Чаты→В работе → open PlayerTester chat → right panel renders StaffRequestCard with admin-chat-staff-request-<dep>, admin-chat-staff-credited='240 RAP', admin-chat-staff-approve button (two-step: click → admin-chat-staff-approve-confirm → RAP credited, card disappears, admin-chat-deposit/admin-chat-rap-input/admin-chat-confirm-button appear, system message 'зачислено 240.00 …' posted). admin-chat-confirm-button is correctly ABSENT while report is in review (no 409 regression). admin-chat-staff-open-report present. Quick command chips row [data-testid=quick-command-chips] rendered above admin-chat-input with /donat, /nick, /wait; clicking /nick inserts '/nick ' into input, clicking /donat sends command immediately and expanded 'DonationAlerts…' message appears in chat. Players tab: added missing admin-players-search + admin-player-row-<sid> data-testids (small fix); searching 'PlayerTester' returns 1 row; selecting opens admin-player-edit with admin-player-balance-input/save; setting balance 12345.67 → deposit-confirm-submit → balance persisted; admin-player-skin-remove-<uid> confirmed removes a skin (count 9→8, toast 'Удалён Chrysalis'). Players table has NO DEMO column. Home page (/) has NO 'DEMO'/'Демо стримера'/'Выберите цель дешевле'/'Максимальный доступный приз' texts and no [data-testid=game-mode-controls] or [data-testid=payout-limit-message]. /api/upgrade works without the forbidden error strings.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerCoinsPanel.jsx was missing data-testid on the search input and on the result row buttons promised by the review request (admin-players-search, admin-player-row-<sid>). Added by the testing agent so Playwright can select rows deterministically. Main agent: consider standardising testids on all admin forms.

StaffRequestCard.jsx: ReportSummary GETs /api/admin/staff-reports/{id} every mount. After approve->onChanged() the card unmounts, so this is fine, but if admin opens multiple chats in a row the request fires once per chat open. Harmless, just noting.

staff_core.takeover sets staff_id='owner' as a sentinel instead of null. The chat scope filter in staff visible_chat is {$or:[{staff_id:null},{staff_id:self.id}]}, so after takeover the chat is no longer in staff's scope (good). But staff.find_one({'session_id': 'owner'...}) would never match — just a reminder that 'owner' is a magic string; DepositForm correctly filters by staff_flow=false.
server.py is 3082 lines (unchanged from prior iterations). Admin player edit routes near 1947 are compact and OK.
/staff and /admin both load /api/{admin,staff}/commands every 20s via CommandComposer. Fine for a small list but consider server-sent updates if command count grows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested data-testids and flows verified: StaffRequestCard approve, takeover UI absent in review state, quick command chips send-immediately vs insert, admin player edit balance+skin-remove, no DEMO artifacts on home or players table)
